text:
olivia: Hey folks — thinking of a small rooftop thing this Friday 6pm? Sunset toast + board games on the terrace. Low-key, bring a blanket if you want. :sparkles:

matt: Love it. Can I bring a +1?

olivia: @matt yes, totally. RSVP so we can estimate snacks.

ravi: I can bring a portable speaker and a tiny bluetooth mic for terrible karaoke. :grin:

sara: Vegetarian here, maybe I'll bring a couple of snack platters (veggie + hummus). Any allergies to watch for?

leo: Weather check — is there a plan if it rains?

olivia: Good q. If light rain we'll move to the mezzanine lounge. If full-on downpour, reschedule to Monday 6. I'll post final call by 3pm Friday.

jin: I can bring a cheese board and some napkins. Also have Settlers of Catan and Uno if people want games.

matt: I'll bring a couple of six-packs and some non-alc seltzers.

ravi: Also bringing a small string light set if it's dim.

olivia: Awesome. Quick poll: react to this thread with :wine: for wine/beer focus, :pizza: for pizza potluck, :game_die: if you want mostly games, :coffee: if you want mocktails/soft drinks only.

leo: :game_die: :coffee:

sara: :pizza: (veg platters here)

jin: :game_die: :wine:

matt: :wine: :pizza:

ravi: :game_die: :wine:

olivia: Great — looks like games + drinks + pizza. I'll put together a shopping list and coordinate drop-offs.

matt: FYI I have one kitchen cooler if we need extra ice.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: rooftop-toasts: Friday 18:00 — 1 reminder at 15:00.

olivia: Thanks everyone! If anyone wants to help fetch food at 5:30, ping here. Otherwise show up with blankets and board-game-ready vibes. :beers: :game_die:
